now.title: Daredevil S2
now.text: Brett Mahoney is an NYPD friend who helps Karen and her friends from inside the department.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A friend Mahoney helps from inside the NYPD.
now.on_b_card_about_a: An NYPD friend who helps Karen.

changes.evidence: Their connection starts in Daredevil S1, not S2: in S1#1 'Into the Ring' Mahoney tips Foggy off about Karen's murder arrest, which brings Nelson and Murdock to her defense, and in S1#9 'Speak of the Devil' he meets Karen and her friends at the morgue about Elena Cardenas's death.

now.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2#3
now.text: Cole North escorts Kirsten McDuffie into the Freeport complex, where she argues with him over denying Jack Duquesne a lawyer.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A lawyer who argues with North over denying Duquesne counsel.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The officer who escorts Kirsten into Freeport and denies Duquesne a lawyer.

proposed.text: Cole North escorts a blindfolded Kirsten McDuffie into the Freeport complex, where she tells him that limiting Jack Duquesne's access to counsel is illegal.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A lawyer who tells North that limiting Duquesne's access to counsel is illegal.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The officer who escorts Kirsten into Freeport and limits her time with Duquesne.

changes.evidence: In Born Again S2#3 Kirsten is Duquesne's lawyer and does see him: North escorts her in blindfolded and gives her fifteen minutes with him. She objects that the unreasonable access to counsel is illegal. Duquesne is not denied a lawyer.

owner_calls.question: Cloak & Dagger#18: Andre talks Lia into letting him take 'just a little' of her hope, takes all of it, leaves her comatose by the roadside and drives off. That is the last thing that happens between them. Should the kind stay boss, or become enemy for this betrayal?
options: Keep boss (he is still the boss who betrays her)
owner_calls.evidence: Lia reluctantly agrees to give Andre a little of her hope, he drains all of it, and he abandons her in a coma (S2E8 = #18). The Fandom page lists Andre under Lia's enemies as a 'Former Ally'.
